Our Story

Two worlds.
One destination.

SnackLoop is deeply rooted in Asian snack culture — curating specialty treats from Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia, and Taiwan. Every product tells a story. Every bite is a small cultural adventure.

BaoPop is the toy universe born from the humble bao bun. Six designer characters that reflect the real emotional spectrum of today's youth — Happy, Chill, Chaos, Work, Overthinking, and Snack. Every unbox is a moment of discovery.

Together, we've built something rare: a third space where you can snack, unbox, and find a version of yourself — all at once.

What We Carry

Four Reasons
to Visit.

Snacks
500+ curated Asian snacks from Japan, Korea, Taiwan, and Southeast Asia — organized by country, flavor, and mood.
Blind Box
BaoPop designer toys — draw on-site, collect the full series, chase the hidden figure. Every unbox a surprise.
Drinks
Specialty beverages to sip while you explore. IP-themed cups, seasonal series, and limited collaborations.
Fun
Photo-worthy installations, seasonal events, workshops, and social spaces. Every visit is content-worthy.
